title: photo/{head_id}/pick payload
description: UPSERT payload of photo/{head_id}/pick: the photo the user chose to show for the figure. Last writer wins: the pick with the greater version replaces the other on every device. "Use default" is a DELETE with an empty payload, never an empty or null url. This schema checks the address's form; a server also refuses an address that is not on its own public media base (isPublicImageUrl). Serialized, at most 644 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

url.description: The public address of one derivative, as ProductImage.url carries it: an https URL of at most 512 characters, a lowercase host (and a port, if the media base has one), the base's path and the 64 lowercase hex characters of the derivative_id. No credentials, query, fragment, percent-encoding, dot segment or file extension.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
